decisions.reason: The FAQ already has a complete message-158 MODIFY updating both Small and Big Block figures, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already changes the Big Block winner count to 3 and draw condition to every 35,000 sales; the $6,000 prize amount remains valid.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already changes the Small Block winner count to 3 and replaces the pool-balance trigger with a 750-sales trigger; the $900 amount remains valid.
Changing block-prize counts and draw cadence does not change the Harbor Quill or ArchiveLedger product names.
The source changes prize quantities and draw cadence but does not change Chainlink VRF, on-chain selection, fairness, verification, or applicable draws.
The source leaves the mint price, affiliate commission, founder share, and Small/Big Block prize-pool destinations unchanged.
Both prize mechanisms remain active, so the Small and Big Block ticket counters, permanent badges, and referral-code metadata remain valid unchanged.
The revised prize counts and draw intervals do not alter how book access, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets behave after NFT transfer.
The source changes prize structure but neither resolves nor changes whether prize payouts are automatic or use the existing one-click claim flow.
The source does not change the referral-ticket recipient or the issuance of 4 Small Block and 3 Big Block tickets per coded referral mint.
Changing draw cadence does not change which tickets are eligible or the rule that each block's tickets are burned and reset after its draw.
The block-prize revision does not affect the Transak provider, fiat methods, conversion asset, email access, or wallet and cryptocurrency prerequisites.
